artworks.title: In the Forest of Conteville  (Dans la foret de Conteville)
artworks.description: The image shows a dense woodland with tall trees and a sunlit clearing in the distance. The view is from within the forest, and the horizon is covered by foliage. There is brighter light on the upper right side of the image, suggesting an open sky. The trees and foliage are detailed with cross-hatching and etching lines to add texture. The color scheme is sepia-toned, giving a classic atmosphere. The tree trunks closer to the viewer are dark, while the clearing beyond is illuminated by filtered light.

artworks.title: Arrivee au Marche
artworks.medium: black chalk on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a road alongside a canal. The view is elevated, showing the road, canal, trees, and structures on the horizon. The style of the sketch is characterized by soft lines and shading, creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. Closest to us, a canal borders the road with some ducks in the water. Figures and carts are seen on the road leading into the distance.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.medium: charcoal and colored chalk on laid blue-gray paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a wide view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is near the center, showing a row of trees and distant hills. Faint clouds mark the skyline. There are figures engaging in activity in the foreground. The sketchy brushstrokes emphasize details in black and white on a muted background. The color palette is mainly monochrome with hints of soft reddish-brown tones. The overall technique blends impressionistic and realistic elements, capturing the rural setting elegantly.

artworks.title: Saint Servan
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 17.8 x 22.7 cm (7 x 8 15/16 in.)
support: 25.9 x 30.5 cm (10 3/16 x 12 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of a town next to a body of water. On the left, a path leads towards the buildings in the center, lined with a low fence. The town in the distance includes buildings of various sizes and shapes, including some towers and domes. One building at the end of the path has smoke curling from its chimney. On the right, a large, dark tower is at the end of a strip of land that juts into the water. Boats can be seen by the shore. There are low hills in the background under the empty sky. The drawing is done in soft gray lines on beige paper.

artworks.title: The House of the King of Poland (Angers)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash

artworks.title: The Departure
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows three people walking in a line. The first person is a woman with her head bent forward and her hand lifted to her face. The second person is a man who walks with his head slightly bowed and holds something under his arm. The third figure is another woman carrying a basket. The individuals are not distinctly detailed, but the man has a beard and wears a hat, while the women have scarves covering their heads. They are clad in long dresses and cloaks. The background consists of tall trees, hills, and foliage, creating an outdoor, rural setting. The image is in sepia tones with pencil and chalk, giving a vintage look.

artworks.title: Boat in Trouble
artworks.medium: oil, casein coating, charcoal, and ink
artworks.description: The image shows a group of four figures, three adults, and one child, only partially visible from their waists up. The central figure is a woman inclined forward, positioned to the left, with her face in profile. She has a shawl covering her head. She wears a long dress and a draped shawl. Behind her to the right are two more figures, also wearing shawls. The child is directly in front of these two figures. The background is abstract and dark, with soft tones and indistinct shapes. The entire scene is rendered in muted brown tones with a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Study of Woman Praying
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up. The individual is in a three-quarter view, with their head turned to the right and looking upward. They have large eyes, a slightly upturned nose, and full lips. Their head is covered with a headscarf or veil. The person is wearing a garment that drapes around the shoulders, with folds indicating fabric texture. Their hands are raised and together in a gesture that may suggest prayer. A ring is visible on their left hand. The background is plain, consisting only of the paper.

artworks.title: Two Monks Seated in a Church
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts two men seated side by side. The man on the right has dark, curly hair and a beard, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. He wears a long robe. The man on the left appears to be looking down at an object in his hand, which resembles a book. He has shorter curly hair and his facial features are less visible. He also wears a robe. The background is composed of shaded and hatched lines, emphasizing the two figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: Peasant and Ass
artworks.description: The image depicts a person and an animal, likely a donkey, on a sloped terrain under a canopy of trees. The person is exerting effort to push or pull something, and there are swirling, textured lines indicating movement in the foliage. The scene is depicted with fine brushstrokes in warm sepia tones, creating a textured and dynamic composition. In the background, faint outlines of trees or foliage can be seen.

artworks.title: The Reapers
artworks.description: Three women are portrayed from the waist up, bent over while harvesting. The woman in the foreground is crouched low, with her body turned slightly to the side. She has a focused facial expression and her head is covered with a cloth. Her clothing is suitable for agricultural work. The woman is holding a bundle of grain or straw in one hand and a sickle in the other. Next to her, another woman, similarly dressed, leans into the task with a concentrated expression. In the background, a third woman is partly obscured, engaged in the same activity. The setting is a field during harvest time, with sheaves of cut grain on the ground. The pencil sketch bears the signature "A. Legros 1907" at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Head of a Horse from the Parthenon
artworks.medium: goldpoint with scraping on white commercially prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a pencil sketch of a horse's head. The drawing shows the head from the neck up to the ears with a focus on the horse's profile. The horse is depicted with its mouth open in a relaxed manner, detailed with delicate pencil strokes. The sketch highlights the horse's eye, nostrils, and mane with fine lines for texture. The background is lightly shaded with no additional elements. In the upper right corner, the signature "A. Legros 1898" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Study of a Workman
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a side profile view from the waist up. He is seated facing left, with a slightly forward hunched posture, resting his arms on his knees or a surface. The man has rugged facial features, a beard with texture, short unkempt hair, and is wearing a jacket and shirt. There are no accessories or objects in the image. The background is plain and the sketch is done in sepia tones on brown paper with pencil or charcoal.

artworks.title: Study of a Greek
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a male figure shown from the waist up. The man is facing forward with his body turned slightly to the side, while his head is turned to look over his shoulder towards the viewer. His facial features are detailed with a nose, cheekbones, and a mustache. The hair is medium length and slightly tousled. He is shirtless, emphasizing the muscular detail of the upper body, and wearing pants or a loose garment from the waist down. There is no jewelry or objects in the image. The background is plain with a simple textured tone, highlighting the figure.

artworks.title: Study of a Man's Figure, Holding Rod behind Back
artworks.description: This image depicts a full nude figure of a male standing. The figure is turned slightly to the left with his right arm raised and his left arm relaxed downward. The figure has defined musculature typical for idealized classical representations. The facial features of the figure include a prominent nose and defined cheekbones. The hair is wavy and short, with light detailing. There is no clothing or jewelry visible. The background is plain with minimal detailing, focusing on the figure. The artwork appears to be rendered in a monochrome sepia tone.

artworks.title: Head of a Child
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person's head and upper torso. The subject's head is tilted slightly to the left, and they are looking upward. The person has a cherubic face with full cheeks, a small, slightly open mouth, a small nose, and large eyes, and they appear to have light skin. Their hair is short and wavy, with soft curls around their face. The person is unclothed, with their bare shoulders and upper chest visible. The drawing has been done in thin red lines on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Head of a Man with a Skullcap
artworks.medium: wash over charcoal, heightened with white,  on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a profile portrait of an elderly man facing to the left. He has pronounced facial features, a long nose, and sagging cheeks. He appears to be wearing a closely fitted hat and dark clothing. The background is a gradient of dark tones, creating a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Man
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil drawing of a person's head and upper shoulders. The figure is slightly turned to one side with their gaze directed downward. The facial features include prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and a soft expression. The person has short, neatly styled parted hair and a subtle mustache. There are no visible clothing details, only bare shoulders blending into the background. There are no visible jewelry or objects held. The background is a plain textured surface. An inscription or signature is visible at the top right corner.

artworks.title: Study from the Antique
artworks.description: This is a drawing on blue paper of a sculpture that depicts a human torso without a head or arms. The sculpture is shown facing slightly to the left. Breasts and a muscled stomach are visible, as well as the top of one thigh. Part of the background is shaded, but most of it is the blue color of the paper.

artworks.title: Woman in a Cloak
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person's upper body facing left. The person is standing with their head covered by a hood, slightly tilted downward, and with one hand partially visible in front of them. The facial features are sketched with minimal detail, showing a generally Caucasian profile with a defined nose and slightly pursed lips. The person is wearing a long, flowing cloak or robe that drapes down to the ground, obscuring their body apart from the outlined hand. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain and unembellished, with a light, solid color contrasting the pencil or sketch-like lines of the cloak.

artworks.title: Centaur Carrying a Tree Trunk
artworks.medium: brown and green ink over graphite
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a centaur lifting a tree trunk in a rocky landscape. We see the centaur from the back, and it has the large trunk over its left shoulder. The background includes trees and a hilly landscape, with some small plants sprouting among the boulders in front of the centaur. The sky is blank except for a few faint swirling lines.

artworks.title: Storm
artworks.medium: watercolor over pen and brown ink
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from an elevated viewpoint with a mist-covered distant horizon. A faint structure, potentially a building, is silhouetted on the right side. The brushstrokes create a soft and ethereal quality, blending elements seamlessly. Dark vegetation fills the left foreground, with a slightly bending tree. The color palette includes deep greens, browns, and blues with a light glow, giving the piece a dreamlike feel. The glow in the center contrasts with the darker areas, inviting viewers to explore hidden details within the scene.

artworks.title: Death and the Woodcutter, 2nd plate (La mort et le bucheron)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a hooded figure and an older person gathering wood in a forest. The image is detailed with fine lines, depicting the hooded figure standing near another figure who is crouching while holding a bundle of sticks. The background shows a forest with detailed trees and foliage.
